t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Experiment with the different coloured gnomes, the height, the side of the screen they are on to find the gnomes which give you the highest number of mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: Use the colour of the gnome, the height (or size of the hat) and the side to work out which combinations give you the most mushrooms. Be adaptable as what worked for several rounds may change.
